Study of Railway bridges
*341. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the new-sitem captioned,
"Railway Staff study bridges abroad",
published in The Times of India dated the
4th November, 2002;
(b) if so, whether there was any
proposal to send a Railway team abroad,
to study inspection methods of bridges, as
reported;
(c) if so, whether any team was sent or
is being sent; and
(d) the justification for sending the team?
Funds to drought/flood affected States
*342. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Centre had decided to
release more funds from the Contingency
Fund, to help the drought and flood affected
States to fund relief efforts, when the funds
from the Calamity Relief Fund are not enough
to meet their demand;
(b)  if so, to what extent the Centre has
released funds to the affected States; and
(c) to what extend the affected States
have utilised these funds?
Bio-pesticide from custard apple
*343. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Institute of Chemical
Technology, Hyderabad, has produced a
Bio-pesticide from the seeds of custard
apple;
(b)  if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Institute applied to the
Central Insecticides Board for a license, to
introduce the product for commercial use,
nearly two years back;
(d) if so, whether the license has been
issued;
(e) if not, the reasons for the delay in
issuing the license;
(f) whether half a dozen important
discoveries made by the above Institute are
pending for clearance from Central
Insecticides Board; and
(g) if so, the reasons for not giving the
clearance?

Allocations for rail over bridges
*344. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of financial allocations by
the centre, for the on-going construction of
rail over-bridges, all over the country, zone-
wise;
(b)  the proposals pending for approval
of the Centre for construction of rail over-
bridges, State-wise; and
(c) the time-frame fixed by Government
for clearance of the pending proposals, in
view of the heavy vehicular traffic?
Closure of fertilizer plants
†*345. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of
CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a)  the details of fertilizers plants closed
down by Government in the country and
the reasons for their closure;
(b)  whether the concerned State
Governments and public of those States
have opposed this move; and
(c)  if so, the action Government are
taking to restart those plants?
Floriculture development in Tamil
Nadu
*346. SHRI P.G. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Integrated Development of
Floriculture, a Central Scheme, is under
implementation in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c)  whether the Ministry propose to
increase the cold storage plants, for the
benefit of such farmers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Indian Council of Veterinary Research
*347. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
any proposal to constitute Indian Council
of Veterinary Research; and
(b)  if so, the details thereof?
Conversion of forest land
*348. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that proposals
from various States have been received by
Government, seeking environmental
clearance for conversion of certain forest
lands, for purposes other than forestry;
(b)  if so, the details and the status of
such proposals, State-wise;
(c)  whether the Karnataka Government
has sought approval for release of forest
land for rehabilitation of tribal families,
displaced on account of Bandipur National
Park and construction of Kanini Reservoir;
and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard?

 Total number of questions—155
Coconut disease in Orissa
2359. SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
coconut crop in Orissa has been facing
threat of mite in coastal districts, where
about 70 per cent of the crop has been
affected, as reported in the Indian Express
dated the 10th September, 2002;
(b) whether Government are also
aware that fund crunch has been holding
preventive measures, as the Central
assistance through Coconut Development
Board is awaited; and
(c) if so, whether the Central assistance
has since been released; if not, by when it
would be released?
Storage facility for onions
2360. SHRI H. K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that no dedicated
storage facility exists to prolong the life
of onions in the country, by which the
farmers are selling their onions at low
prices; and
518
(b) if  so, the details of steps
Government propose to take to establish
storage facilities for onions in the
country?
Doubling the foodgrains production
2361. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have drawn
up an ambitious plan to double the
foodgrains  production in ten years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what are the crops identified under
the scheme; and
(d) the subsidies and other fiscal
incentives proposed under the scheme?
Drop in agricultural production
2362. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the overall agricultural
production is expected to drop by 4.9 per
cent during 2002-03;
(b) if so, whether the foodgrains
production would decline by 5.8 per cent
and non-food crops by 3.6 per cent;

519

(c) whether with the revival of rains
in  August, sowing of kharif crops has
been taken up again; and
(d) if so, to what extent the shortage
of rains has affected the kharif crops and
the rabi crops?
Horticulture Development in Himachal
Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir
2363. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to encourage horticulture in
Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and
Kashmir and to train the farmers in the
trade;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount proposed to be
allocated for each of the above States
during 2002-2003?
Prices of pulses
2364. SHRI RUMANDLA RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a decline
in the production of pulses due to the
drought situation this monsoon; and
(b) if so, the corrective steps taken to
keep prices of pulses down?
Procurement of copra by NAFED
2365. SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether NAFED had started
procurement of copra this season, on the
new MSP;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
NOC from NAFED for export of
foodgrains
†2366. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) to which countries foodgrains have
been exported by NAFED during the last
three years and the varieties, quantities
and rates of such foodgrains;
(b) whether exports have been made
by private traders and cooperative
institutions also after obtaining No
Objection Certificate (NOC) from
NAFED;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether gross irregularities are
committed and commission is taken for
issuing NOC; and
(e) whether Government would get the
matter probed through CBI?
Coconut Fibre Technological Research
Institute in Kerala
2367. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Agriculture and Coir
Minister of Kerala has written to the
Minister regarding the urgent need for
establishment of a Coconut Fibre
Technological Research Institute in the
State, by the Indian Council of
Agricultural Research; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's response thereto?

Andhra Pradesh

RAO: Will the Minister of AGRICUL-
TURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether NAFED had undertaken
procurement of chillies in the recent past
in Andhra Pradesh under Market
Intervention Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what were the terms and conditions
approved by the Ministry in this regard?
